status_rules.foundation: OBrush has related shipped behavior, no reference parity proven. Different policies/ranges/defaults are explicit gates, not automatic passes.
status_rules.absent: No matching0.1.14 exposed workflow/data representation found.
status_rules.unverified: Host/framework behavior may exist but no scoped proof.
status_rules.demonstrably_inactive: Pinned registration/commented source proves not exposed upstream; deployed runtime remains separately auditable.
status_rules.external: Source/config does not prove service availability; no account actions executed.
status_rules.parity_verified: Every declared active behavior/interchange/usability/performance gate passes against separately identified reference runtime on declared supported hosts.

cross_cutting_gate: Run the normal native and browser UI route; record reference and OBrush input/build hashes, exact settings, output differences, history and saved fields. No name-only or build-only promotion.

required_fixture_catalogue.description: Independently generated sphere, noisy plane and thin double-shell; nonuniform mask/RGB/roughness/metallic; known normals and asymmetric rasters.
Triangle/quad/mixed meshes with independent face-corner UV seams, colored/material gradients and a known checker PNG.
Three translated/rotated/scaled parts, hidden/selected subsets and overlapping surfaces; no copied user/proprietary fixtures.
Loop/Catmull-produced reversible meshes, irreversible topology, connected/disconnected solids, holes/open boundaries and intersections.
Independent OBJ/SGLv1–3/PLYASCII+LEbinary/STLASCII+colorbinary fixtures, malformed/truncated/oversize cases with exact expected fields.
Same captured viewport/logicalcoordinates/DPR and real event routing; sparse/dense motion, modifiers/touch/pen pressures0/.25/.5/1 and release/cancel barriers.

Same machine/browser/GPU and10K/100K/1M meshes where feasible;60s/120s repeated400motion-event/s input, frame and per-dab time, final-release response/tail, memory and geometryquality. Capacity failures are retained, no theoretical cap counts as execution.

comparison_policy.numerical_and_visual_gates: Preregister per-feature outputs and tolerances before matched execution; record maximum/RMS errors, response amplitude/width, normal/roughness, topology counts/manifoldness, image/color policy and reference failures. Algorithm differences can remain only where the declared functional capability and quality gate is met; no quiet substitution of an incomplete workflow.
comparison_policy.performance_gate: Preregister same-input/host responsiveness and memory/geometry-quality thresholds from user requirement and reference feasibility; report distributions and long-stroke release tail. Short synthetic quietness is not physical input latency or full parity.
comparison_policy.commercial_reference: No new ZBrush binary/license/source/account reads or GUI interactions in this task; SculptGL source is MIT and separately preserved.
